subject.title: improve: let Code Mode use declared tool result shapes

question: Should OpenClaw commit to `outputSchema` as the public plugin SDK contract for structured `AgentToolResult.details`, including strict post-hook validation for tools that opt in?
rationale: The implementation is technically coherent and well-proven, but adding a shipped plugin API and defining its failure semantics is a permanent product and compatibility decision that review automation cannot authorize.

options.title: Adopt the public contract
options.body: Accept the optional field and strict opted-in validation as the canonical result-shape API shared by Code Mode and Tool Search.

options.title: Keep schemas internal
options.body: Remove the public plugin SDK and documentation surface while retaining output hints only for selected core-owned tool descriptors.

options.title: Pause the feature
options.body: Keep unknown result shapes until maintainers have a broader typed tool-result design covering success, structured errors, hooks, and remote tools.

recommendation.title: Adopt the public contract
recommendation.body: Accept the optional field and strict opted-in validation as the canonical result-shape API shared by Code Mode and Tool Search.

likelyOwner.reason: This person introduced and recently maintained the merged Code Mode catalog and performance work that the proposed API extends.
